reading.ru: И тараны его будут бить в стены твои, и орудия его разрушат башни твои.
reading.question: What weapons and tactics will be used to attack Tyre's fortifications?
options: Battering rams will strike the walls and siege weapons will destroy the towers
Fire will be set to the buildings and arrows will rain down
The walls will be undermined and the gates will be breached
Naval forces will bombard from the sea
reading.correct: Battering rams will strike the walls and siege weapons will destroy the towers
reading.explain: The text explicitly mentions тараны (battering rams) striking the walls and орудия (weapons) destroying the towers.

reading.ru: Тараны его будут бить в стены твои.
reading.question: What will the battering rams target?
reading.explain: The text specifies that the battering rams будут бить в стены (will strike the walls).

reading.ru: И орудия его разрушат башни твои.
reading.question: What will the siege weapons destroy?
reading.explain: The passage states that орудия разрушат башни (the weapons will destroy the towers).

reading.ru: Тараны его будут бить в стены твои, и орудия его разрушат башни твои.
reading.question: What is the sequence of destruction described?
options: Walls are attacked first, then towers are destroyed
Towers fall first, then walls collapse
The harbor is attacked before the walls
reading.correct: Walls are attacked first, then towers are destroyed
reading.explain: The verse lists the battering rams striking the walls first, followed by the siege weapons destroying the towers.

reading.question: What does this statement emphasize about Tyre's defenses?
options: Even the towers (the highest fortifications) will be destroyed
reading.correct: Even the towers (the highest fortifications) will be destroyed
reading.explain: The destruction of towers emphasizes the totality of the devastation to come.

reading.ru: И тараны его будут бить в стены твои.
reading.question: What is the role of battering rams in the siege?
options: To break down the walls by repeated strikes
To dig tunnels under the city
reading.correct: To break down the walls by repeated strikes
reading.explain: Battering rams were siege weapons designed to break walls by repeated impacts.
